Two-Group Label-Permutation Null Generator

Source: R/scale_space_resampling.R
make_null_fun_twosample.Rd

Builds an observed two-group statistic map and deterministic fixed-size label-permutation null draws.

Usage

make_null_fun_twosample(
  subject_images,
  group,
  mask = NULL,
  n_perm = 1000,
  seed = NULL,
  variance = c("welch", "pooled"),
  z_equiv = TRUE,
  template = NULL
)

Arguments

subject_images

List of subject-level 3D images, or a subject-by-voxel matrix with template/mask.

group

Two-level group label.

mask

Optional logical mask.

n_perm

Number of label permutations.

seed

Optional random seed.

variance

"welch" (default) or "pooled".

z_equiv

If TRUE, return Z-equivalent maps; otherwise return t maps.

template

Optional template for matrix inputs.

Value

List with stat_vol, mask, deterministic null_fun, and metadata.
